checks.evidence: menus.html breaks register: "Our curated seasonal menus elevate every gathering with farm-to-table flavor." No contractions and two stock words, while index, about and the newsletter are plain and specific ("We cook in East Vancouver every morning and deliver by 11:45."). One piece breaks: partial.

Every page and the newsletter tell the same story: office lunches and weddings cooked from BC produce, named farms, delivery by 11:45. The farm-to-table line breaks a brand rule (B5) but no page contradicts another.

Credible: Dana Whitfield, office manager, Northshore Credit Union, quoted exactly as recorded, permission yes; founders named with experience (about.html). Unsupported: "Trusted for 500+ events across the Lower Mainland" (index.html) is not in brand memory. Some unsupported proof beside credible proof: partial.

/img/menu-autumn.jpg has no alt text (menus.html); heading "harvest table" on menus.html against "Harvest Table" elsewhere. Other alt text is descriptive; titles share one format. A few gaps: partial.
